capabilities: Read the World English Bible offline
Study verses with Berean interlinear and Strong's entries
Import and manage local Bible resources
extras: No telemetry, accounts or cloud service; the stable distribution omits the full King James Version; compressed publisher modules and gzip imports on iPadOS need 16.4 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read, search and study Bible text with original-language resources offline.

relations.evidence: Publisher downloads contact the MySword publisher at mysword-bible.info when you select an install or repair.

summary: Offline Bible reader and study tool with World English Bible text, Berean interlinear word study, search, highlighting and a local resource library.
